record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.context_brief: Liminf control of Sobolev and BV seminorms
record.original_question: With Ω and Φ_{λ,p}(u) as above, for every 1<p<∞ does there exist C=C(p,N,Ω) such that all measurable u satisfy ||∇u||_{L^p}^p ≤ C liminf_{λ→∞} λΦ_{λ,p}(u), interpreting ||∇u||_{L^p}=∞ when u∉W^{1,p}(Ω)? Similarly, for p=1 does there exist C=C(N,Ω) such that ||∇u||_M ≤ C liminf_{λ→∞} λΦ_{λ,1}(u), where ||∇u||_M is total variation for BV functions and ∞ outside BV?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 9.2 ([BSVY, Section 7.2]). Given any 1 < p < ∞, is there a constant C = C(p, N, Ω) such that, for all measurable functions u, (9.5) k∇ukp Lp ≤ C lim inf λ→∞ λΦλ,p(u)? in the sense that k∇ukLp = ∞ if u /∈ W1,p(Ω). Similarly for p = 1, is there a constant C = C(N, Ω) such that, for all measurable functions u, (9.6) k∇ukM ≤ C lim inf λ→∞ λΦλ,1(u)? where k∇ukM denotes the total mass of ∇u if u ∈ BV (Ω), and k∇ukM = ∞ if u /∈ BV (Ω).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb{R}^N$ be a smooth bounded domain (or $\Omega=\mathbb{R}^N$). For $\lambda>0$, $1\le p<\infty$, and a measurable function $u:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, define
$$\Phi_{\lambda,p}(u)\;=\;\int\!\!\!\int_{\{(x,y)\in\Omega\times\Omega\;:\;|u(x)-u(y)|>\lambda|x-y|^{1+N/p}\}}\frac{dx\,dy}{|x-y|^{N}},$$
i.e. the (weighted) measure of the set of pairs $(x,y)\in\Omega\times\Omega$ for which $|u(x)-u(y)|>\lambda|x-y|^{1+N/p}$, measured with the weight $|x-y|^{-N}$.

Adopt the convention that $\|\nabla u\|_{L^p(\Omega)}=\infty$ whenever $u\notin W^{1,p}(\Omega)$, and that the total variation $\|\nabla u\|_{\mathcal{M}(\Omega)}=\infty$ whenever $u\notin BV(\Omega)$.

(a) For every $1<p<\infty$, does there exist a constant $C=C(p,N,\Omega)$ such that for every measurable function $u:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$
$$\|\nabla u\|_{L^p(\Omega)}^{p}\;\le\;C\,\liminf_{\lambda\to\infty}\lambda\,\Phi_{\lambda,p}(u)\,?$$

(b) For $p=1$, does there exist a constant $C=C(N,\Omega)$ such that for every measurable function $u:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$
$$\|\nabla u\|_{\mathcal{M}(\Omega)}\;\le\;C\,\liminf_{\lambda\to\infty}\lambda\,\Phi_{\lambda,1}(u)\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: Recent works (Brezis–Seeger–Van Schaftingen–Yung in Analysis & PDE 17 (2024) and Nguyen's 2025 preprint on nonlocal characterizations of Sobolev norms and total variation) discuss sharp upper bounds in terms of $\limsup \lambda^p\nu_\gamma(E_{\lambda,\gamma/p}[u])$ and related $L^{p,\infty}$ quasinorm characterizations, but the $\liminf$ control formulated here — particularly the BV case ($p=1$) — is not established in the literature found and is still cited as open. The status is therefore open.

status_evidence.title: Brezis–Seeger–Van Schaftingen–Yung, Analysis & PDE 17 (2024)
status_evidence.snippet: Sharp upper bounds for limsup λ^p ν_γ(E_{λ,γ/p}[u]); for p=1 upper bounds for L^{1,∞} quasinorms fail in γ∈[-1,0).
status_evidence.claim: Related characterizations are proved but the liminf-type inequality and BV analog remain unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Nguyen, Characterizations of the Sobolev norms and the total variation via nonlocal functionals (arXiv:2507.00842)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies nonlocal functionals characterizing Sobolev norms and total variation; addresses related but distinct inequalities.
status_evidence.claim: Does not establish the requested liminf lower bound on ||∇u||_{L^p}^p or on ||∇u||_M.
